svg.text: Chat with PDF — cited answers highlighted in yellow
upload → PyMuPDF / Tesseract OCR → chunks + word boxes → Cohere Embed v4 → Qdrant · question → Rerank 3.5 → Claude Sonnet 4.6 with verbatim quotes → aligned, scored, highlighted on the PDF
03 · CHAT — grounded answer, every claim highlighted in yellow
Answers come only from the document. Claude must return each statement with a verbatim quote from a numbered source; with no supporting passage it says the document doesn't contain the answer.
Highlights are exact, not approximate. Every word's box is stored at ingestion (0–1 page coordinates); the quote is aligned to those words and drawn as yellow overlays on the PDF.js canvas.
The match % is measured, not self-reported. score = 0.7 × Cohere Rerank(statement, cited passage) + 0.3 × quote fidelity, capped at 45% when a number in the statement is missing from the source.
Arabic and scanned PDFs are first-class. Tesseract ara+eng OCR, ligature and RTL table repair, and Arabic-Indic digits normalised before matching and statistics extraction.
Per-user and private. httpOnly JWT cookie, ownership check on every document route, PDF magic-byte and size validation, S3 server-side encryption.
Docker Compose locally · ECS Fargate / App Runner / EC2 + RDS + S3 on AWS
